_readme.logo_offset: Where the wing sits in the logo canvas, in canvas units from its position in the reference image. [x, y], +x right, +y down. [0, 0] = exactly as the original.
_readme.favicon_offset: Nudge of the wing inside the favicon, in favicon canvas units, from centered. [x, y].
_readme.favicon_fill: Share of the favicon side taken by the wing's width (0-1). The rest is the safe area that keeps it clear of the rounded corners.
_readme.favicon_corner_radius: Rounded corners of the favicon, as a fraction of the side. 0 = square.
